queries.text: Why did the EU's AI Act enter into force in phases between 2024 and 2027, and what do the different deadlines require?
Date the EU AI Act entered into force in 2024
Specific date when prohibitions on unacceptable risk AI systems apply starting August 2025
Specific date when obligations for general-purpose AI models and high-risk Annex III applications start applying in August 2026

Specific date when full compliance requirements for high-risk AI systems embedded in regulated products under Union harmonization legislation become applicable in August 2030 or 2027 as per final text amendments
List of prohibited AI practices defined by Article 5 that must be complied with immediately upon entry into force
Definition of General-Purpose AI (GPAI) model thresholds regarding compute power parameters used to determine regulatory scope (2024, 2027)

search_hits.title: The EU AI Act's phased entry into force (2024-2027)
search_hits.snippet: The EU AI Act — the world's first comprehensive AI law — entered into force 2024-08-01 with obligations phased through 2027.
